name: khan-academy-timer
description: Question timer overlay for Khan Academy exercises and quizzes. Microsoft Edge (Chromium), Manifest V3.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:edge

pnpm.comment: Vitest pulls in Rollup, whose platform-native binding cannot be loaded in environments where the Node binary runs under the macOS hardened runtime. The pure-WebAssembly Rollup is API-identical and removes that native dependency; see README 'Troubleshooting'.
